copy_zh.benefit: 逐项检查 OpenAI 兼容接口的流式输出、工具调用和结构化输出。先预览请求，再比较网关或模型升级前后的报告。

projects.scope_note: The seven endpoint probes observe specific sample behaviors. Inference is opt-in and can be billable. Demo requests use a local mock server.

projects.name: ReconTrail
projects.tagline_zh: 从照片到可检查的几何
projects.description_en: Check photo quality, reconstruct sparse 3D geometry on a CPU, and share a self-contained interactive report that opens offline.
projects.description_zh: 检查照片质量，在 CPU 上重建稀疏三维几何，并分享可离线打开的交互报告。

copy_en.benefit: Check photo quality, reconstruct sparse 3D geometry on a CPU, and share a self-contained interactive report that opens offline.

copy_zh.benefit: 检查照片质量，在 CPU 上重建稀疏三维几何，并分享可离线打开的交互报告。

projects.scope_note: The ordinary photo path yields sparse geometry at arbitrary scale. Calibrated stereo is a separate path with scale determined by calibration.

projects.name: TF Route Audit
projects.tagline_zh: 检查 TF 路径与时间
projects.description_en: Check exported TF records and native URDF for cycles, disconnected frames and conflicting edges. Query routes against observed time windows.
projects.description_zh: 检查导出的 TF 记录与原生 URDF 中的环路、断连和边冲突，并根据观测时间范围查询路径。

copy_en.benefit: Check exported TF records and native URDF for cycles, disconnected frames and conflicting edges. Query routes against observed time windows.

copy_zh.benefit: 检查导出的 TF 记录与原生 URDF 中的环路、断连和边冲突，并根据观测时间范围查询路径。

projects.scope_note: Card claims are limited to the current documented workflow.

projects.name: SSE Toolcall Audit
projects.tagline_zh: 检查流式工具调用的组装
projects.description_en: Reassemble parallel tool calls from saved SSE captures and check completion markers, JSON arguments and consistency with a saved final response.
projects.description_zh: 从保存的 SSE 流中重组并行工具调用，检查结束标记、JSON 参数及与已保存最终响应的一致性。

copy_en.benefit: Reassemble parallel tool calls from saved SSE captures and check completion markers, JSON arguments and consistency with a saved final response.

copy_zh.benefit: 从保存的 SSE 流中重组并行工具调用，检查结束标记、JSON 参数及与已保存最终响应的一致性。

projects.scope_note: Audits saved captures and compares saved responses. It does not make live model calls or execute returned tools.

projects.name: Pose Convention Bridge
projects.description_en: Convert camera poses between OpenCV and OpenGL axes or world-to-camera and camera-to-world forms, with validated transforms and Nerfstudio export.
projects.description_zh: 转换 OpenCV/OpenGL 坐标轴与世界到相机、相机到世界位姿，校验刚体变换并导出 Nerfstudio 格式。

copy_en.benefit: Convert camera poses between OpenCV and OpenGL axes or world-to-camera and camera-to-world forms, with validated transforms and Nerfstudio export.

copy_zh.benefit: 转换 OpenCV/OpenGL 坐标轴与世界到相机、相机到世界位姿，校验刚体变换并导出 Nerfstudio 格式。

projects.scope_note: Inputs must explicitly declare conventions. Nerfstudio export requires real filenames and supplied intrinsics.

projects.name: COLMAP Model Audit
projects.description_en: Audit COLMAP text models for camera-field errors, broken reciprocal tracks and disconnected view graphs, with optional image-path and model-overlap checks.
projects.description_zh: 检查 COLMAP 文本模型的相机字段、互相引用的轨迹及视图连接图的连通性，还可核对图像路径与模型重叠。

copy_en.benefit: Audit COLMAP text models for camera-field errors, broken reciprocal tracks and disconnected view graphs, with optional image-path and model-overlap checks.

copy_zh.benefit: 检查 COLMAP 文本模型的相机字段、互相引用的轨迹及视图连接图的连通性，还可核对图像路径与模型重叠。

projects.scope_note: Audits the legacy COLMAP camera/image/point text representation. It does not establish ground-truth reconstruction accuracy.

projects.name: Tooltrace Audit
projects.description_en: Review saved execution traces for overlapping retries, duplicate attempts and unmatched results. Add the optional recorder around your own tool calls.
projects.description_zh: 分析保存的执行轨迹，定位重叠重试、重复尝试与未匹配结果。可为自己的工具调用接入可选记录器。

copy_en.benefit: Review saved execution traces for overlapping retries, duplicate attempts and unmatched results. Add the optional recorder around your own tool calls.

copy_zh.benefit: 分析保存的执行轨迹，定位重叠重试、重复尝试与未匹配结果。可为自己的工具调用接入可选记录器。

projects.scope_note: Card claims are limited to the current documented workflow.

projects.name: Research to Fix
projects.tagline_en: Connect prior solutions to local fixes
projects.tagline_zh: 把已有方案连接到本地修复
projects.description_en: Research similar failures, map relevant solutions to your code and verify the repair. Save cases with source links and before-and-after evidence.
projects.description_zh: 研究相似故障，将适用方案映射到本地代码并验证修复。连同来源和前后对照证据保存案例。

copy_en.benefit: Research similar failures, map relevant solutions to your code and verify the repair. Save cases with source links and before-and-after evidence.

copy_zh.benefit: 研究相似故障，将适用方案映射到本地代码并验证修复。连同来源和前后对照证据保存案例。

projects.scope_note: Card claims are limited to the current documented workflow.

projects.name: Debate Direction
projects.description_en: Let two agents propose, challenge and revise a plan. Keep the objections, remaining disagreements and next validation steps in a reviewable report.
projects.description_zh: 让两个智能体提出、质疑并迭代方案，将异议、未决分歧和下一步验证保留在可审阅报告中。

copy_en.benefit: Let two agents propose, challenge and revise a plan. Keep the objections, remaining disagreements and next validation steps in a reviewable report.

copy_zh.benefit: 让两个智能体提出、质疑并迭代方案，将异议、未决分歧和下一步验证保留在可审阅报告中。

projects.scope_note: Card claims are limited to the current documented workflow.

projects.name: StewardCheck
projects.tagline_en: Tie coding changes to test receipts
projects.tagline_zh: 让代码改动对应验证记录
projects.description_en: Pin a task baseline, inspect edits against the agreed scope and keep test receipts tied to the files they actually checked.
projects.description_zh: 固定任务起点，按约定范围检查改动，并让测试记录对应其实际检查的文件状态。

copy_en.benefit: Pin a task baseline, inspect edits against the agreed scope and keep test receipts tied to the files they actually checked.

copy_zh.benefit: 固定任务起点，按约定范围检查改动，并让测试记录对应其实际检查的文件状态。

projects.scope_note: StewardCheck is a 0.2.0 Alpha CLI inside ai-dev-steward. The separate agent skill is documented as v1.1.0. Receipts bind declared checks to recorded workspace state, not to a guarantee of correctness.

projects.name: Agent Action Notifier
projects.tagline_en: Receive an alert when work needs you
projects.tagline_zh: 在任务需要你时收到通知
projects.description_en: Turn explicit workflow events into queued email or desktop alerts, with pending-request tracking, retries and recovery after interrupted delivery.
projects.description_zh: 将明确的工作流事件转为排队发送的邮件或桌面通知，追踪待处理请求、重试，并在发送中断后恢复。

copy_en.benefit: Turn explicit workflow events into queued email or desktop alerts, with pending-request tracking, retries and recovery after interrupted delivery.

copy_zh.benefit: 将明确的工作流事件转为排队发送的邮件或桌面通知，追踪待处理请求、重试，并在发送中断后恢复。

projects.scope_note: Notifications are produced from explicit workflow events. The tool does not automatically monitor ChatGPT. SMTP acceptance and local popup command acceptance are recorded separately from actual user delivery.
